Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Sanjeev Kumar Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s :
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR
ORAL ORDER 4 26-09-2025 Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner.

2. The present application has been filed for transfer of Matrimonial (Annulment) Case No.77 of 2023 filed under Section 12-1(c) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 from the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Banka to the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Katihar.

3. Learned Advocate for the petitioner submitted that besides the fact that the petitioner was subjected to torture at the hands of the opposite party leading to institution of Korha P.S. Case No.171 of 2023 registered for the offence punishable under Section 498A/34 of the I.P.C., the petitioner is facing severe financial crunch and not getting any support from her husband.

She also filed a Maintenance Case No.178/2023, which is pending in the Court of learned Principal Judge,
Patna High Court MJC No.3070 of 2024(4) dt.26-09-2025 Family Court, Katihar.
